Thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below: 

- Referral split: 15% of gross services revenue (standard for partner-introduced services). We can make that configurable in the PSA appendix if you need a band.
- Marketplace clause: we don't impose mandatory marketplace exclusivity — there's a short notice + opt-in clause in section 4.2 of the PSA.
- Timeline: pilot = 6 weeks (integration + validation), then rolling production on a per-account basis.
- SLA: For the pilot we can commit to benchmarked vector lookup P99 latency under the pilot load; formal production SLA requires a capacity review.

Attached: updated SOW_outline.pdf (includes suggested milestones) and a DocuSign link for the PSA if you want to execute quickly: https://www.docusign.com/sign?tmpl=PNC-PSA-2028.

If Monday 7/2 9am PT works, I'll send a calendar invite and include our solutions engineer (Jordan) and a technical PM.

Best,
Olivia

Appreciate the clarity, Olivia. Quick technical items from the SOW review:

2) Milestone B (latency validation): please confirm expected QPS for the pilot. We'll provision a dedicated dev pool for the 6-week window but need the numbers to size correctly.
3) Test harness: we will supply a synthetic workload and a validation test plan; would expect Pinecone to run parallel validation.

If you can add a short table with expected QPS + index sizes to the SOW, we can finalize technical acceptance criteria. Also: can Jordan add his recommended rollback criteria in the SOW appendix?
